title: 第二十章 歪打正着
novel_title: 长夜君主全本目录更新未删减(方彻)
content_zh: 范天条沉吟着。“方彻这边，也必须要再次重视起来，不管是如何的机缘巧合，但是他的入教洗礼，居然有印神宫亲自参加，那就不凡。必然有过人之处，否则，印神宫不会这么闲。”“是的。换做你我，如果一个天才考试，我们或许会有兴趣过去看看，但若是普通武生考试，你会有兴趣吗？”“没有。”“那不就得了？”“还有就是，这条消息很明显的显示，方彻已经加入了一心教，而且通过了洗礼。”陈入海笃定道。“这刚才不是说过了？”范天条理清了情报内容，终于心情轻松一下，面容愁苦的看着陈入海，有些同情道：“老陈，虽然我看你也不顺眼，但还是要提醒你一句。”“什么？”“有时间的话，去找梦神医去看看脑子吧。真的。”“滚你娘的！”……几天后。午夜时分。距离碧波城一千来里路的铁血堡遭受一心教袭击。铁血堡乃是镇守者联盟的势力，向来与镇守大殿一南一北，守护这一片平安。这一次一心教筹划已久，大举来袭，出动的皇级高手就有五位，王级高手若干，显然，乃是想要以雷霆万钧之势，一举拔掉铁血堡这个钉子。印神宫亲自坐镇指挥，调集了附近大量一心教高手秘密到来。这个行动已经筹划了半年多了，终于开始实施。结果一开始攻击就感觉到了不对劲。午夜时分。印神宫一挥手。立即有高手发动进攻，四面八方飞入铁血堡。轰的一声，铁血堡大门飞上了天。墙壁也瞬间倒塌一大片。如狼似虎的一心教高手，蒙着脸冲了进去。一声大吼，响彻夜空。“杀！”“一个不留！”残酷的战斗，瞬间打响。鲜血在一瞬间，就几乎铺满了地面。一声长啸，无数身影从铁血堡中腾起迎战。顿时长啸，钟声，喊声，杀戮声，惨叫声，响彻一团。铁血堡在一开始的时候慌乱了片刻，牺牲的确不小；但是随着铁血堡中的人手冲出，战局就变得胶着。然后意外就发生了。双方交战不超过一个呼吸的时间，骤然间夜幕中人影重重，无数镇守大殿的高手突然四面八方而来。毫不犹豫的加入战场。而且出动阵容非常豪华，瞬间就打了一個防守反击！从战力来讲，足足准备了半年的一心教居然就这么落入了下风！铁血堡立即发动反攻。内外配合，全力战斗，而且呈包围状圈上来。差点将一心教的人包了饺子。没奈何，一直在观战指挥的印神宫与三大供奉亲自出手，抵挡住镇守者高手，率领部下拼命突围，一番血战之后，才带着一干手下逃之夭夭。但是却也损失了四名王级高手，十几名将级高手，而先天大宗师级别的高手，足足有五十多位，陨落在这里。可说是大伤元气。神奇的是……一心教本来是集中优势兵力来突袭的，结果最后竟然变成了突围！突袭和突围虽然只差一个字，但是……这特么不是一回事好吧。本来就不应该出现的事情，就这么离奇的出现了。所有人都是一个想法：内鬼！事后，印神宫大发雷霆：“查！彻查！定然是有人走漏了风声，否则，镇守者如何可能来的这么及时？！”但无论如何查，也是没有半点头绪。便在这时，在镇守者大殿的卧底传来消息：此事完全是巧了。原来一头传说级别的超阶妖兽烈焰红狐被追杀逃到了这边，而东南镇守大殿主召集了若干高手，其中甚至包括数位殿主，乃是正在追杀妖兽。而那天的时候，这头烈焰红狐正好逃到了铁血堡附近。于是大殿主率领所有高手潜过去准备抓博猎杀，结果就在那个时候一心教出击了。没办法大殿主只好舍弃烈焰红狐来救援铁血堡，哪知道正好迎头碰上了印神宫的一心教在行动。这件事情，据说镇守者内部也是十分惊喜。居然一下子打到了正主儿，哎呀这事儿办的，啧啧，真是漂亮。成功破坏了一心教的行动，而且是一心教教主印神宫亲自率领策划的行动。简直是惊喜。好多年没有过的巨大胜利。现在，镇守者大殿正在庆功……虽然烈焰红狐逃走了，但是能破坏此计划，并且击杀了一心教那么多高手，便是超出预料的巨大胜利。比起抓住烈焰红狐，可强得多了。值得庆祝。印神宫接到这个消息，直接气的眼前发黑，一口气憋在胸口，胸闷的半天都没说出话来。所有一心教高层，都是一头黑线。每个人都感觉，一口老槽闷在了喉咙里，吐不出来，咽不下去。特么的，就这么寸？！这么大的损失，差不多都伤筋动骨了。
content_en: Fan Tiantiao pondered."Fang Che's side must also pay attention again. No matter what kind of coincidence it is, but his baptism was actually attended by the Yin Shen Palace in person, which is extraordinary. There must be something extraordinary, otherwise, the Yin Shen Palace would not be so idle." "Yes. If it were you and me, if a genius takes the examWe might be interested in taking a look, but would you be interested if it were an ordinary martial arts exam?" "No." "That's fine, then?" "Also, this news clearly shows that Fang Che has joined the Yixin Sect and passed the baptism.""Didn't I just say this?" Fan Tiantiao sorted out the information and finally felt relaxed. He looked at Chen Ruhai with a sad face and said with some sympathy: "Old Chen, although I don't like you, I still want to remind you." "What?" "If you have time, go to Dr. Meng to have a look at your brain. Really." "Fuck you!"... A few days later.At midnight.The Iron Blood Castle, a thousand miles away from Bibo City, was attacked by the Yixin Cult.The Iron Blood Castle is a force of the Guardian Alliance, and has always been guarding the north and south of the main hall to protect this peace.This time, the Yixin Sect has been planning for a long time and launched a massive attack. There were five emperor-level experts and several king-level experts dispatched. Obviously, they wanted to pull out the nail in the Iron Blood Castle with a thunderous momentum.Yinshen Palace personally took command and mobilized a large number of nearby Yixinjiao masters to arrive secretly.This action has been planned for more than half a year and has finally been implemented.As a result, I felt something was wrong as soon as I started attacking.At midnight.Yinshen Palace waved his hand.Immediately some masters launched an attack and flew into the Iron-blooded Fortress from all directions.With a bang, the gate of Iron Blood Castle flew into the sky.A large section of the wall collapsed instantly.The wolf-like master Yi Xin taught him and rushed in with his face covered.A loud roar echoed through the night sky."Kill!" "Leave no one alive!" The brutal battle started instantly.In an instant, blood almost covered the ground.With a long roar, countless figures rose up from the Iron Blood Castle to fight.Suddenly, there were roars, bells, shouts, killing sounds, and screams, all resounding throughout the crowd.The Iron-blooded Fort was panicked for a moment at the beginning, and the sacrifice was indeed not small; but as the men in the Iron-blooded Fort rushed out, the battle became stalemate.Then the unexpected happened.The two sides fought for less than one breath. Suddenly, there were many figures in the night, and countless masters guarding the hall suddenly came from all directions.Join the battlefield without hesitation.And the lineup was very luxurious, and they launched a defensive counterattack in an instant!In terms of combat power, the Yixinjiao, which had been preparing for half a year, actually fell into a disadvantage!Ironblood Castle immediately launched a counterattack.Cooperate with the inside and outside, fight with all your strength, and surround them in a circle.I almost made dumplings for the people taught by Yi Xin.Having no choice but to watch and direct the battle, the Yin Shen Palace and the three major worshipers personally took action to resist the defenders' masters and led their men to break through desperately. After a bloody battle, they escaped with a group of their men.However, they also lost four king-level experts, a dozen general-level experts, and more than fifty innate grandmaster-level experts died here.It can be said to be a great loss of vitality.The amazing thing is... The Yixin Sect originally concentrated its superior forces for a surprise attack, but in the end it turned into a breakout!Although there is only one word different between raid and breakout, but... these are not the same thing.Things that shouldn't have happened in the first place happened so bizarrely.Everyone has the same idea: the mole!Afterwards, Yin Shen Palace was furious: "Check! Thoroughly investigate! Someone must have leaked the news, otherwise, how could the defenders have arrived in such time?!" However, no matter how he checked, there was no clue.At this moment, news came from the undercover in the Guardian's Hall: This incident was completely coincidental.It turned out that a legendary super-level monster, the flaming red fox, was being hunted and fled here. The master of the southeast guard palace summoned several masters, including several palace masters, to hunt down the monster.On that day, the flaming red fox happened to escape near the Iron-blooded Fortress.So the master of the hall led all the masters to sneak over and prepare to capture Bo, but at that time the Yixinjiao attacked.The master of the main hall had no choice but to abandon the flaming red fox to rescue the Iron-Blooded Castle. Unexpectedly, he happened to encounter the Yixin Sect of the Yin Shen Palace in action.It is said that the defenders were also very surprised about this matter.He actually hit the rightful owner all at once. Hey, this was done, tsk tsk, it’s really beautiful.The operation of the Yixin Sect was successfully destroyed, and it was an action planned by the leader of the Yixin Sect, Yinshen Palace.What a surprise.A huge victory not experienced in many years.Now, the Guardian Hall is celebrating... Although the Flame Red Fox has escaped, but being able to destroy this plan and kill so many masters from the Yixin Cult is a huge victory beyond expectations.It's much better than catching the flaming red fox.Worth celebrating.When Yinshen Palace received the news, his eyes turned black with anger, and he held a breath in his chest. His chest was so tight that he couldn't speak for a long time.All the top leaders of Yixinjiao have a black streak.Everyone feels that a piece of old shit is stuck in their throat, and they can't spit it out or swallow it.What the hell, just that big?!Such a huge loss is almost debilitating.
